'''DS-75-5''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE pilot]] who served<ref name="CSWE" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] launched an [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attack]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> DS-75-5 was among the TIE [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who partook in the subsequent battle,<ref name="CSWE" /> where numerous [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] unsuccessfully attempted to defend the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] from the attacking Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was ultimately destroyed in an Alliance victory over the Empire.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
DS-75-5 was created for [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
